title: Custom Styles Manifest
description: A file format for describing system-level CSS custom properties in a web component design system. Complements custom-elements.json (per-element CSS) by describing the global style foundation.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the custom styles schema

cssCustomProperties.description: Global CSS custom properties available for use on any element.

name.description: The CSS custom property name including -- prefix

value.description: Default resolved value. May reference other custom properties.

type.description: The kind of CSS value this property represents. Helps tooling provide appropriate UI.

tags.description: Categorical tags for discovery and filtering
